what.action: Two-commit session opening the membership-acquisition axis — first a safety+extraction cut on HomeScreen to free file-size headroom for Phase D/E surface, then Phase E1 substrate landing the AuthRule discriminated-union with the six-kind JoinPolicy.
what.summary: Commit 09926a1 — MembershipModal now React.lazy from HomeScreen (matching the OrgRulesEditor pattern from SettingsScreen); Identity-tab Officials + Members-issued sections extracted into new sibling OrgIdentitySections.tsx (~116 lines). HomeScreen dropped from 796 to 725 lines, chunk dropped from ~17.8KB to 17.22KB gz, new MembershipModal chunk at 2.84KB gz under a 4KB named budget. Commit 9989bc0 — Phase 8 Phase E1 from the open-joining brief. AuthRule extended to a discriminated union: AuthRuleForOrgAction preserves the existing {action, threshold, eligible} shape; new AuthRuleForJoin carries {action: 'join', policy: JoinPolicy} where JoinPolicy is a six-kind union (open / allow_list / deny_list / requires_handshake / requires_credential / requires_vouch). Dispatch in encode/decode/buildAuthSubtree is by action name — 'join' takes the policy path, anything else takes the {threshold, eligible} path; pre-E1 declarations decode unchanged. Type guards isOrgActionRule + isJoinRule let consumers narrow. defaultAuthRules tightened to AuthRuleForOrgAction[]. Three rule-consumers narrow via the guard at the lookup boundary: MembershipModal, CosignRequestModal, verifyOrgAuthorization. SettingsScreen state + OrgRulesEditor props tightened to AuthRuleForOrgAction. New test file authRule.test.ts ships 22 round-trip + validation tests. governance/manifest.ts notes extended. authRule chunk named (1.38KB gz under 3KB budget); previously fell through to catch-all. 162/162 tests (was 140; +22 new), all four gates green across both commits, no existing-budget bumps.

why.text: Operator prompt 'Fire it up and cut the next code until context is full and good a stopping point' on a SessionStart-injected handoff from origin/main that named caller-wiring as the recommended first move. Carpenter grounded against the branch and caught that caller-wiring had already shipped in d0283b4 (the prior session pushed to the dispatch branch per protocol; the merge to main hasn't happened from the cockpit yet). Re-oriented via chip-form direction question; operator picked the largest of the four options (HomeScreen lazy-load + Phase E1) without hesitation. Cut order was deliberate: the lazy-load adds source lines that would push HomeScreen past the 800-line hard limit, so the extraction of OrgIdentitySections was load-bearing for the lazy-load before any new substrate could land. Then Phase E1 opens the membership-acquisition axis that Phases E2-E4 build on top of, perpendicular to the org-control axis (Phases A-D) that Phase C just closed end-to-end.

outcome.notes: [P-001] HomeScreen lazy-loads MembershipModal; OrgIdentitySections extracted; HomeScreen 796→725 lines, chunk 17.8→17.22KB gz, new MembershipModal chunk 2.84KB gz (commit 09926a1). [P-002] AuthRule discriminated-union shipped per Phase E1 brief; six JoinPolicy kinds; dispatch-by-action-name preserves back-compat (commit 9989bc0). [P-003] Three lookup-boundary consumers narrowed via isOrgActionRule type guard; SettingsScreen state + OrgRulesEditor props tightened to AuthRuleForOrgAction. [P-004] authRule.test.ts ships 22 new tests covering each policy kind round-trip + validation rejects + back-compat. [P-005] governance/manifest.ts notes extended + tests file added to touches; wallet-core/manifest.ts touches list extended with OrgIdentitySections; scripts/bundle-budget.mjs gained two named budgets (MembershipModal 4KB, authRule 3KB). [P-006] All four gates green across both commits; 162/162 tests; no existing-budget bumps. [FEEDBACK→Foreman]: Phase E2 pre-brief should name the file-placement decision (createSelfMembership.ts vs append to createMembership.ts), reference the existing 'membership-receive' / 'recovery-share-receive' inbox-routing pattern as the model for the new 'self-membership-receive' action, and flag that the acceptor handler in Phase E2 is wired but no-op (real evaluation against the join-rule ships in Phase E3).
